LESSON: TAWBAH (REPENTANCE)

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.2: Tawbah (Repentance)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Tawbah (Repentance), part of Devotional Acts in Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why should a Muslim seek repentance from Allah (S.W.T.)? 2. How should Muslims seek repentance from Allah (S.W.T.)?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on the conditions for tawbah and present them on a chart,

2. discuss the significance of tawbah (Q25:70, Q39:53) in pairs/groups and make a class presentation,

3. dramatise ways of seeking forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.),

4. search for Hadith on tawbah online or from available reference materials individually/ in pairs/groups and draw lessons from them. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the conditions for tawbah and present them on a chart,
2. discuss the significance of tawbah (Q25:70, Q39:53) in pairs/groups and make a class presentation,
3. dramatise ways of seeking forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.),
4. search for Hadith on tawbah online or from available reference materials individually/ in pairs/groups and draw lessons from them. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Tawbah (Repentance) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy enhanced as learners search for the Hadith on tawbah online

• Communication and Collaboration enhanced as learners discuss the significance of tawbah (Q25:70, Q39:53) and make

class presentations

• Creativity and Imagination is enhanced as learners dramatise ways of seeking forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.)

Values:
Responsibility is enhanced as learners take responsibility for their actions and seek forgiveness from Allah (S.W.T.).

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Decision-making and Problem-solving skill is enhanced as learners learn to seek forgiveness for their mistakes
